about: Run 2: a second batch through the same network, fully simulated. With run 1's episodes in memory the worker contacts Corner Mart before Queen St Grocer answers. Every tin is found and held, sold or returned, so this recall closes.

recall.instruction: Stop selling Maple Farm milk powder 800 g from batch B-5120. Take every tin of that batch off the shelf, keep the tins apart from stock for sale, and return them to Maple Farm Foods. Customers who bought a tin can bring it back to the store for a refund.

checks.label: Affected unit
checks.question: Read me the batch code printed under one tin.

checks.label: Sales are counted
checks.question: Open the item sales report on the till. How many have sold since the delivery?
checks.rule: sold needs a count read from the till

checks.label: Removal took effect
checks.question: Scan one tin at the till. Did the till refuse the sale?

parties.name: Harbour Market
parties.profile: Independent grocery on Queens Quay by the Toronto waterfront. Sells baby food and formula from one aisle and keeps a small back room. The store manager answers the phone during opening hours.

parties.name: Queen St Grocer
parties.profile: Independent grocer on Queen St W in Parkdale, Toronto. Orders more stock than its shelves need and sells the extra cases on to small corner stores nearby. Keeps its invoices on paper.

parties.name: Lakeside Foods
parties.profile: Grocery store on Lake Shore Blvd W in Mimico, Etobicoke. Pulls recalled stock the same day and ships it back to the supplier with return slips.

directory.name: Corner Mart
directory.profile: Convenience store in Parkdale, Toronto. Buys its baby formula by the case from a local grocer, not from a distributor. Its till and stock records report to the recall. The store manager answers a mobile phone.

initial.say: Delivery note D N five one eight seven seven. Eighteen sold on the till report, twelve pulled; the code is B-5120 and the till refuses them.
Ten sold, fifty pulled. Code B-5120, and the till refuses them.
Forty sold, twenty pulled and held, thirty went to Corner Mart.
We received thirty and pulled all of them as soon as the notice came. The code is B-5120 and the till refuses the scan.

expected.note: Hand-computed. mass_balance must equal 180 after every step. Corner Mart's reply must land after Queen St Grocer's claim: until the sender reports the transfer there is no edge to book the receipt against.
